import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000009;
    static final long INF = MOD * MOD;
    
    static long modPow(long x, long n, long m) {
        long res = 1;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) res = res * x % m;
            x = x * x % m;
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    static class ModInt {
        long n;
        
        ModInt() {
            n = 0;
        }
        
        ModInt(long m) {
            n = m % MOD;
            if (n < 0) n += MOD;
        }
        
        ModInt add(ModInt b) {
            n = (n + b.n) % MOD;
            if (n >= MOD) n -= MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt sub(ModInt b) {
            n = (n - b.n) % MOD;
            if (n < 0) n += MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt mul(ModInt b) {
            n = n * b.n % MOD;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt pow(long exp) {
            return new ModInt(modPow(n, exp, MOD));
        }
        
        ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(modPow(n, MOD - 2, MOD));
        }
        
        ModInt div(ModInt b) {
            return mul(b.inv());
        }
        
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(n);
        }
    }
    
    static final int MAX_N = 1 << 18;
    static ModInt[] fact = new ModInt[MAX_N];
    static ModInt[] factinv = new ModInt[MAX_N];
    
    static void init_f() {
        fact[0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N - 1; i++) {
            fact[i + 1] = new ModInt(fact[i].n * (i + 1) % MOD);
        }
        factinv[MAX_N - 1] = fact[MAX_N - 1].inv();
        for (int i = MAX_N - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            factinv[i] = new ModInt(factinv[i + 1].n * (i + 1) % MOD);
        }
    }
    
    static ModInt comb(int a, int b) {
        if (a < 0 || b < 0 || a < b) return new ModInt(0);
        ModInt res = fact[a];
        res = res.mul(factinv[b]);
        res = res.mul(factinv[a - b]);
        return res;
    }
    
    static class Pair {
        ModInt first;
        ModInt second;
        
        Pair(ModInt f, ModInt s) {
            first = f;
            second = s;
        }
    }
    
    static Pair mul(Pair a, Pair b) {
        ModInt f = a.first.mul(b.first);
        ModInt s = a.second.mul(b.first).add(a.first.mul(b.second));
        return new Pair(f, s);
    }
    
    static Pair plu(Pair a, Pair b) {
        ModInt f = a.first.add(b.first);
        ModInt s = a.second.add(b.second);
        return new Pair(f, s);
    }
    
    static Pair[] dp = new Pair[501];
    static boolean[] used = new boolean[501];
    
    static void init() {
        init_f();
        dp[0] = new Pair(new ModInt(1), new ModInt(0));
        dp[1] = new Pair(new ModInt(2), new ModInt(0));
        
        for (int n = 2; n <= 500; n++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ModInt cnt = new ModInt(n + 1);
                ModInt sum = new ModInt(0);
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    long diff = Math.abs(j - k);
                    sum = sum.add(new ModInt(diff));
                }
                Pair cl = dp[j];
                Pair cr = dp[n - 1 - j];
                Pair x = mul(cl, cr);
                ModInt c = comb(n - 1, j);
                x.first = x.first.mul(c);
                x.second = x.second.mul(c);
                x = mul(x, new Pair(cnt, sum));
                dp[n] = plu(dp[n], x);
            }
        }
    }
    
    static Pair[][] dp2 = new Pair[502][501];
    
    static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        long newMod = sc.nextLong();
        MOD = newMod;
        
        init();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= m; k++) {
                dp2[i][k] = new Pair(new ModInt(0), new ModInt(0));
            }
        }
        
        dp2[0][0] = new Pair(new ModInt(1), new ModInt(0));
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= i; k++) {
                for (int j = i; j < n; j++) {
                    int ni = j + 2;
                    ni = Math.min(ni, n);
                    int nk = k + j - i + 1;
                    if (nk <= m) {
                        Pair x = mul(dp2[i][k], dp[j - i + 1]);
                        ModInt c = comb(nk, k);
                        x.first = x.first.mul(c);
                        x.second = x.second.mul(c);
                        dp2[ni][nk] = plu(dp2[ni][nk], x);
                    }
                }
                dp2[i + 1][k] = plu(dp2[i + 1][k], dp2[i][k]);
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(dp2[n][m].second);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
